notes.title: 'Demon Go!' New Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/234044fe7380c5a3b0b47325f5c2b2badd32e5b7.png


 Stage level has been significantly adjusted.
 The difficulty level of the boss stage has been adjusted.
 Fixed a bug that resulted in an arrival goal without clearing the boss on some boss stages.
 Improved Ui convenience.
 You can play in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Spanish, Russian, French, Italian, and Thai!


Feel free to send your comments to the email address below for language translation issues and various comments on the game!

[artifact.games.1024@gmail.com]

We'll work hard to prepare the next update to become a fun Demon Go!

notes.title: 'Demon Go!' 1.1.8 version updated.
notes.notes:
'Demon Go!' 1.1.8 version updates.

1. The new store system has been added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/36f36f54260831c3c6d8fcadc1d631bd61160218.png

Gather 24 different types of items with different abilities!
The item is no longer a consumable item.
Once purchased, you can keep it forever!
Try the stage by replacing items according to your strategy!


2. The hell roulette is new!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/dfb6e461b5d3871ccf414602147a619324dd57a9.png

If you clear the new stage for the first time, you can spin the hell roulette. Get Gold Rewards!



We are preparing a new update to become an interesting 'Demon Go!'

Please look forward to the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/9bbbd4afd71792130dd7fce52ade40196c0b0a17.png

notes.title: Demon Go! Update v1.1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/d01d3186682fae73dc844dd7fe8c754b7887d688.png

Demon Go! Update v1.1.3

- The problem that sound settings were initialized has been resolved.
- Some stage levels have changed.
- Added music for each chapter.
- Some tutorial content has been modified.

We'll update it to make it more fun 'Demon Go!'.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Version Updates
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42623016/9bbbd4afd71792130dd7fce52ade40196c0b0a17.png

- The mouse cursor disappears when you enter the game stage.
- The star acquisition conditions for some stages have been modified.
- You can initialize game data in the Options category.
- If you run the game for the first time after installing the game, you can initially select the game language.

We will prepare the next update to become a fun Demon Go!
